chunks: Who, ignoring the Reality, engage in pleasantries.

key_terms.خَوْض: Idle talk or play; engaging in something with a lack of seriousness or depth
key_terms.يَلْعَبُونَ: They play; engaging in amusement or diversion

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran describes people as engaging in 'khawd' (idle talk)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (often linked to Surah Al-Mu'minun in broader contexts, though cited here as 'The Mount') characterizes the 'mubtilun' (those who nullify their deeds) who engage in 'khawd'—idle, frivolous discourse that distracts from spiritual accountability. Scholars emphasize that this 'play' is not merely leisure but a deliberate avoidance of serious reflection on the Hereafter, rendering their good deeds void due to lack of sincerity and presence of mind.
